string.name: instructions_text
string.value: Welcome to use the developer's bill of lading function. When you encounter any problems, please bill of lading in a timely manner to collect corresponding time logs and submit them for research and development positioning.

string.name: instructions_step_one
string.value: 1.Click on New Question Sheet to enter the bill of lading page.

string.name: instructions_step_two
string.value: 2.Follow the prompts to select or enter the contents of the bill of lading.

string.name: instructions_step_three
string.value: 3.Click the 'Submit' button to proceed with the bill of lading.

string.name: instructions_warning
string.value: The bill of lading process requires maintaining network connectivity
